# indiefa.st

> Curated indie maker tool directory — one hand-picked tool per journey stage from idea to scale, plus Grow sub-tracks for automate, scale, community, support, SEO, and distribution.

indiefa.st helps solo founders and indie hackers discover, validate, build, ship, monetize, measure, and grow products without tool-list paralysis. Each stage has editorial blog guidance and affiliate-backed tool picks with discounts where available.

## Full documentation

- [Complete LLM reference (text)](https://indiefa.st/llms-full.txt): All 58 tools with pricing, reasoning, affiliate URLs, blog posts, navigation, and site metadata
- [Complete LLM reference (markdown)](https://indiefa.st/llms-full.md): Identical content to llms-full.txt

## Featured tool picks

- Apify (2. Research): Full-stack web scraping and data extraction platform with ecosystem for building deploying and publishing web scrapers AI agents and automation tools.
- ClickFunnels (3. Validate): Sales funnel builder platform to convert online visitors into paying customers with optimized landing pages checkout flows and marketing automation.
- DirStarter (6. Build): Next.js directory website template boilerplate for quickly building and launching online directory listing websites with modern tech stack.
- FaceUp (10. Measure): EU anonymous whistleblowing & ethics compliance platform. Lets employees report misconduct, fraud & HR issues safely. Used by 3,600+ orgs in 70+ countries.
- Feather-so (11. Grow): Platform to publish SEO-friendly blogs from Notion collect emails and send high-deliverability newsletters with no coding or design skills required.
- MailerLite (9. Monetize): Email marketing platform with transactional emails automation newsletters landing pages websites and forms for growing audience engagement.
- Mangools (1. Discover): Affordable all-in-one SEO tool suite for keyword research SERP analysis rank tracking backlink checking and competitor analysis across LLMs.
- Outrank-so (11. Grow): Programmatic SEO automation that generates blog posts backlinks and optimization recommendations on autopilot to grow organic traffic while you sleep.
- Outseta (9. Monetize): All-in-one membership and SaaS platform combining CRM email marketing payments authentication and customer management for scaling businesses.
- PostSyncer (11. Grow): Social media scheduling tool managing Instagram Facebook LinkedIn TikTok Pinterest YouTube Telegram BlueSky Threads, X and now Mastodon with AI video creation.
- Revid-ai (11. Grow): Create viral videos in Minutes! Turn your creative ideas into attention-grabbing TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube stories with just a few clicks. All you need is a story to tell - revid.ai handles the rest.
- ShipAhead (6. Build): Nuxt boilerplate for shipping AI SaaS products in hours with authentication payments and all features needed to launch and stay ahead.
- Supastarter (6. Build): Scalable production-ready Next.js, Nuxt and TanStack Start SaaS starter kit with authentication payments API and features trusted by 1350+ developers.
- Super-so (11. Grow): Tool for turning Notion documents into fully customized professional websites with SEO optimization high performance and instant page loads.
- Synthesia (11. Grow): AI video platform for business creating studio-quality videos with AI avatars and voiceovers in 160+ languages saving 90% time and cost.
- Turbo0 (8. Ship): Launch Site (high potential!)
- Uneed-best (8. Ship): Launch Site (high potential!)
- Wispr Flow (4. Plan): Voice-to-text AI turning speech into clear polished writing 4x faster than typing in every app on Mac Windows and iPhone with auto-edits.
- Linkto (8. Ship): Unlock Explosive Growth with this FREE List of 800+ SaaS Directories and 75+ Launch Sites
- Chrome Goldmine (1. Discover): A complete database of 9,656 expired Chrome extensions - each with revenue estimates, rebuild difficulty, competitor gaps, and a step-by-step launch plan.
- MiroMiro (4. Plan): A Chrome extension for designers, developers, and no-code builders that turns any website into copy-paste code, colors, fonts, and assets - so you can ship faster and save hours.
